high_level_description: The image depicts a large, historic-looking building with a prominent clock tower at the center. The architecture is classical, featuring a red-brick facade with white trim around the windows and a green dome atop the clock tower. The building has multiple stories, with large arched windows on the second floor and smaller rectangular windows on the lower floors. There are trees surrounding the building, some of which have green leaves, suggesting it might be spring or summer.
